Tools like task managers, calendars, and productivity apps support time management but should not replace developing strong habits like prioritizing effectively and protecting focus time. Time management tools range from simple calendars and to-do lists to complex software that automates scheduling and monitors productivity trends, providing structure, prioritizing tasks, and minimizing distractions. The Pomodoro technique and time blocking are also popular methods for managing time efficiently.
